summary: A0 systematically tested hyperparameter variations after confirming a2's learning rate improvements. Adopted a3's scalar_lr and weight_decay tuning, achieving new best score of 0.995253 (0.995457 -> 0.995253). Tested batch size (64 vs 128), weight decay (0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2), and scalar_lr (0.3, 0.35, 0.4, 0.5) variations. Evidence confirms: LRs 0.8/0.006/0.06 optimal, weight_decay 0.1 optimal, scalar_lr 0.35 optimal (sweet spot between aggressive 0.5 and conservative 0.3). No warmup beneficial. Architecture and activation changes all hurt performance.
